- Cross-check by opening specific old revisions to confirm an image is present.
- If needed, use Wayback Machine snapshots for visual confirmation.

We will prioritize direct article revisions before considering template transclusions.

mistake_reason: At step 12, WebSurfer stated they would re-open and verify the 2009 diff (which had just been found to introduce the image on 19/02/2009), but instead shifted to inspecting the Template:Thomas Aquinas history and asserted 11/09/2015 as the first picture on the page. This contradicted the prior confirmed reasoning and plan focused on the article's direct image addition, causing a reasoning-action mismatch (FM-2.6) that led the team to adopt the wrong date.
